subject: general
question: Ishu starts from Point P and drives 8 km towards the west. Then she takes a right turn, drives 13 km, she turns right again and drives 15 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 5 km, turns right again and drives 7 km and stops at Point Q. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point P again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Ishu starts from P and drives 8 km West.

She turns right → 13 km North.

She turns right → 15 km East.

She turns right → 5 km South.

She turns right → 7 km West and stops at Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa285ff1c8c5e74a179275d8afecbcd6cf056c808ba4f75a25e1312c304f6786.png] 

So, To reach P from Q → move 8 km South.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
